name: Carpre
text: Carpre is a variant spelling of the name Cairbre. Readers meet this shorter form mainly as a cross-reference in older dictionaries. The fuller headword Cairbre carries the real figures and their stories. This entry exists so that a search for Carpre still lands in the right place.

attributes.attribute: an Irish personal name held by several early heroes

okr.objective: Document the Carpre cross-reference to Cairbre.
